title: Jesus… Do You Still Love Me?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus… I did something really wrong. 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. And I still want you to come to Me. ❤️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But… I'm scared You don't love me anymore. 💔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: My love for you doesn't disappear when you fail.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. Come back to Me. Don't run away from Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever felt too guilty to come back to God? ❤️

bible.text: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
